precedence.merge: No merge of generated bytes with hand-edits; regenerate discards them.
precedence.rule: The registry is the only SSOT; generated files never override it.
precedence.tie_break: Duplicate registry ids FAIL-CLOSED and generation aborts.

expressibility.catalogue_claim: Typed registry entries generate plugin, catalogs, and deployments
expressibility.first_non_expressible_construct: opaque passthrough blob field in the registry
expressibility.structural_rule: Typed registry entry with additionalProperties false

determinism_contract.statement: generate(registry) is a pure function of registry bytes and generator_version

hand_edit_rule.detectable: TAMPERED iff bytes differ and the registry entry digest still matches
